scope: Offline native read-back content/identity/visible-metadata/relationship preservation. Not application acceptance, test execution, human approval, production readiness or live-provider evidence.

metadata_scope.compared: Every captured issue field except intentional description/updatedAt; cycle/assignee/estimate presence and any values are preserved. Set-like label/relation ordering may differ; all full members/types/values remain exact.
metadata_scope.limitation: A field omitted by the native full-issue response is not a separately queried backend null; this verifier cannot certify unobserved provider fields.
